Topic.label: Basic Straightedge and Compass Constructions: Copying an Angle and Constructing an Angle Bisector

Question: Use a straightedge and compass to construct the bisector \(OP\) of \(\angle AOB\) (\(OC=OD\), \(CP=DP\), and \(P\) lies inside the angle). If \(\angle AOB=70^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle AOP\) in degrees.
Solution: By SSS, \(\triangle OCP\cong\triangle ODP\), so \(OP\) bisects \(\angle AOB\), and \(\angle AOP=70^\circ\div2=35^\circ\).
